Marta Lopez: Heads up: GCP marketplace invoice has a usage line tied to sku 'inference-pro-1' with no reseller mapping. amount $3,450.
Ethan Zhao: can you paste the line? we need subscription_id + buyer info.
Marta Lopez: CSV snippet: `sku,subscription_id,amount,buyer_id\nINFERENCE-PRO-1,sub-gcp-993,3450,` (buyer_id empty)
Ben (finance): amount under $5k so finance can approve manual credit if needed, but we should try to get GCP to reassign first.
Marta Lopez: opened GCP case 555-1122. attached ingestion logs: `marketplace_ingest: missing_buyer for sub-gcp-993`.
invoicing-bot: Invoice 2026-03-20 GCP-2245 queued for reconciliation.
Ethan Zhao: action: (1) Marta follow GCP case and request corrected buyer mapping (owner: Marta), (2) Ben hold reseller payout for that line until mapping confirmed (owner: Ben), (3) if GCP cannot reassign within 7d finance can issue one-time manual credit (owner: Ben).
Ben (finance): acknowledged. I'll post suspense GL 2205 for $3,450.
Marta Lopez: I'll update here when GCP responds. :thumbsup:
